name: readonly-sales-query
sql: SELECT v.vendor_name,m.item_name,o.status,sum(oi.quantity*oi.price_at_order) AS sales FROM vendor v JOIN menu_item m USING(vendor_id) JOIN order_item oi USING(item_id) JOIN customer_order o USING(order_id) WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY v.vendor_name,m.item_name,o.status ORDER BY 1,2;
